'''Er'Kits''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] of tall and thin [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Er'Kit system/Legends|Er'Kit system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Er'Kit/Legends|Er'Kit]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Er'Kits were slightly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in appearance and were characterized by their long [[Limb/Legends|limbs]],<ref name="SWCTP" /> tough hides, and elongated,<ref name="TPMVD" /> conical craniums.<ref name="SWCTP" /> Members of the species identified with at least the male [[Gender/Legends|gender]]<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|odymandrell|Mandrell, Ody}}</ref> and their skin was light blue with pink and yellow stripes in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="TPMVD" />

The planet Er'Kit was represented by the Er'Kit [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. He was arrested on charges of implication in a [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian]] slave ring.<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}}</ref> [[Xenonutritionist|Xenonutritionists]] used the Er'Kit [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]] as an example to conclude that Er'Kits fed off adrenaline and speed.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|odymandrell|Mandrell, Ody}}</ref>
